title: First-row decomposition
statement: Let $t,u$ be bits, let $b$ be a finite bit string, and let $j,k$ be nonnegative integers. Define the row sum for a bit $t$, string $b$, and indices $j,k$ by summing over positions $q$ in $b$ the product of $t$ and the bit of $b$ at $q$ when $k+q=j$, and $0$ otherwise; a missing bit is taken to be $0$. The row sum for $t$ and the string formed by placing $u$ before $b$, at indices $j,k$, equals the term $t u$ when $k=j$ (and $0$ otherwise), plus the row sum for $t,b$ at indices $j,k+1$.
